book.name: Jon
book.title: Toto Thovuye Utuniye Jon Le Rorori

content: Thɨ vaidiya wevo eunda i yathima
Ko Jisas va i wa Olivɨ e ghanji Ou.
Ighɨviya vena, vambe mbaŋambaŋa moli, Jisas i njogha e Ŋgolo Boboma ghayayao tɨne. Gharɨgharɨko wolaghɨye thɨ meghɨliŋa, amba i yaku na i vavaghare weŋgi.
Mbaro gharavavaghare na Parisi thɨ vaŋguruwo wevo eunda. Thɨ vaidi i yathima. Thɨ vandeghathɨŋa e ghamwanji
na thɨ dagewe Jisas thɨŋa, “Ravavaghare, wevoke iyake kaero wo vaidi i yathima weiye amala regha.
Ghinda la mbaro i menawe Mosese iŋa thoŋgo ra vaidiya wevo ŋgorake ra tagavamare e varɨ. Ghen ŋgoroŋga len renuwaŋa?”
Va thɨ utu na ŋgoreiyako kaiwae va nuwanjiya thɨ vaidiya le kwan amba ghawonjowe i menawe. Ko iyemaeŋge Jisas va i kururu na i rorori e thelauko vwatae e nɨmae kɨkiye,
na thiye mbe lenji vaito eŋge. Jisas i yondovirɨ amba i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Thoŋgo ghemina regha ma ele tharɨ, amalaghɨniye i dukai vara varɨwe.”
Mbowo i kururuva na i rorori e thelauko vwatae.
Mbaŋa thɨ loŋwe utuutu iyako, regha iya i raŋgi; matuwoŋgiko thɨ rakaraŋgikai. Jisas ghamberegha moli thɨ itete weiye wevoma mbe i ndendeghathɨ.
I wovaira ghamwae na i dagewe iŋa, “Elana, aŋgama inanji? Ma regha me ronjogha na i wovatharɨtharɨŋaŋge, ae?”
Iŋa, “Amalana, ma regha.” Jisas iŋa, “Ghino tembe ŋgoreiyeva, ma ya wovatharɨtharɨŋaŋge. U wa, thava tene mbaŋa reghava u vakatha tharɨ.”
Jisas iye rameyambaneke lenji manjamanjala
Jisas mbowo i utuva weŋgiya gharɨgharɨ iŋa, “Ghino rameyambaneke lenji manjamanjala. Thela thoŋgo i ghambuŋgo, ne i vaidiya yawaliye ghamanjamanjala, ko mane mbaŋa regha i loŋga e momouwo.”
Parisi thɨ dagewe thɨŋa, “Tembe ghanɨmbereghava u utuŋa utunin. Iya kaiwae len utuna ma i emunjoru.”

Jisas i gonjogha weŋgi iŋa, “Othembe ya utuŋa wombereghake utuniŋgu, ko iyemaeŋge budakaiya ya utuŋa iye utu emunjoru, kaiwae ya ghareghare aŋgava ya mena na aŋgane ya reŋa. Ko ghemi ma hu ghareghare aŋgava ya mena o aŋgane ya reŋa.
Ghemi hu ghathaŋgo ŋgoreiya gharɨgharɨ lenji renuwaŋa, ko ghino ma ya ghatha lolo regha.
Ko iyemaeŋge thoŋgo ghino ya ghatha lolo na yaŋa i tharɨ lo ghathako iyako emunjoru kaiwae ma ghino womberegha ya ghatha, Bwebwe iye va i variyeŋgo, amalaghɨniye weiŋgu.
E lemi Mbarona tɨne va thɨ rori ŋgoreiye, thoŋgo gharɨgharɨ theghewo thɨŋa ŋgoreiye, lenji utuko utu emunjoru.
Regha maiyavara ghinoke, ya utu wombereghake kaiwaŋgu, na Bwebwe, iye va i variyeŋgo tembe i utuva ghino kaiwaŋgu.”
Thɨ vaito thɨŋa, “Rama aŋga inae?” Jisas i gonjogha weŋgi iŋa, “Ma hu ghareghareŋgo na tembe ma hu ghareghareva Bwebwe. Thoŋgo hu ghareghareŋgo mbala tembe hu ghareghareva Bwebwe.”

Va i utuŋa utuutuŋgike thiyake mbaŋa va i vavaghare e Ŋgolo Boboma tɨne, e valɨvaŋga ŋgora gharɨgharɨ lenji mwaewo mani ghaghamba bigirawe. Ko iyemaeŋge ma lolo regha i mando na i yalawe kaiwae ma vamba ghambaŋa.
Mane hu wa ŋgora ghino ya wakewe
Jisas mbowo i dageva weŋgi iŋa, “Nevole ya wareri, na nevole hu tamweŋgo, ko nevole huya mare lemi tharɨna kaiwanji. Ma valɨkaiwami hu wa ŋgora ghino ya wakewe.”
Jiu lenji randeviva thɨ vedage weŋgi thɨŋa, “Mbwatane i unɨgha ghamberegha iya kaiwae iŋake, ‘Ma valɨkaiwami hu wa ŋgora ghino ya wakewe’?”
I gotubwe iŋa, “Ghemi hu mena e ghembake iyake, ko ghino ya mena e ghembake yavoroke e buruburu. Ghemi hu mena e yambaneke, ko ghino ma ya mena e yambaneke.
Iya kaiwae ma dage weŋga na maŋa ne hu mare lemi tharɨ kaiwanji, thoŋgo ma hu loŋweghathɨ ghino, mbema iya ya utuŋaŋgoke, ne hu mare lemi tharɨ kaiwanji.”
Thɨ vaito thɨŋa, “Thela ghen?” Jisas i gonjogha weŋgi iŋa, “Ghino mbema iyava ya utuuta utuniŋguma weŋga mbaŋa va ra rikowe na ra menake.
Renuwaŋa i ghanagha moli ina weŋgo na ya utuŋa kaiwami na ya wovatharɨtharɨŋaŋga. Ko thela iye va i variyeŋgo, iye vareminje inawe. Budakaiya va ya loŋwewe ya utuŋa weŋgiya rameyambane.”
Mava nuwanjiko i manjamanjala Jisas va i utuuta Ramae utuniye.

Iya kaiwae va iŋa, “Mbaŋa ne hu mwanavaira Lolo Nariye, amba ne hu ghareghare Ghino mbema iya ya utuŋaŋgoke. Ma ya vakatha bigi regha wombereghake, ko ya utuŋa budakaiya Bwebwe i vaghareŋgo na ya utuŋa.
Thela va i variyeŋgo iye weiŋgu; ma i roiteteŋgo na womberegha moli, kaiwae lo vakatha mbaŋake wolaghɨye i vakatha na i warari.”
Mbaŋa va i utuŋa utuutuŋgike thiyake, gharɨgharɨ lemoyo thɨ loŋweghathɨ.
Loi nariye i rakayathuŋgiya gharɨgharɨ lenji tharɨ e tɨne
Jisas i dage weŋgiya Jiu, iya thavala va thɨ loŋweghathɨ iŋa, “Thoŋgo hu vikikiya lo vavaghareke, emunjoru woraghambugha ghemi.
Ambane hu ghareghare emunjoru Loi kaiwae na i rakayathuŋga.”
Thiye thɨ gonjoghawe thɨŋa, “Ghime Eibraham orumburumbuya ghime, na ma mbaŋa regha lolo regha le mbaro i variime. Ŋgoroŋga gharumwaru iya uŋake, ‘Ne i rakayathuŋga’?”
Jisas i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Ya dage emunjoru e ghemi, thavala thɨ vakatha tharɨ, thɨ tabo tharɨko le rakakaiwobwaga.
Rakakaiwobwaga mane i roghabana giyako i kaiwokowe ele ŋgolo tɨne, ko iyemaeŋge nariye ne i roghabana moli e tɨne.
Iya kaiwae thoŋgo Loi Nariye i rakayathuŋga, ghemi rakarakayathuŋga moli.
Ya ghareghare Eibraham orumburumbuya ghemi, ko iyemaeŋge hu munjeva hu unɨghɨŋgo kaiwae lo utuke ma e ghambaghambae e gharemina.
Ghino ya utuŋa weŋga budakaiya va ya thuwe weya Bwebwe na ghemi hu vakatha budakaiya va hu loŋwe weya ramami.”
Thɨ gonjoghawe thɨŋa, “Ghime ramameya Eibraham.” Jisas i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Thoŋgo emunjoru Eibraham le ŋgaŋga ghemi, mbala hu vakatha ŋgoreiya amalaghɨniye va i vakatha.
Wo hu thuwe, va ya utuŋa emunjoru budakaiya ya loŋwe weya Loi, ko iyemaeŋge hu munjeva hu unɨghɨŋgo. Eibraham mava i vakatha bigi regha ŋgoreiya iyake.
Budakaiya hu vakavakatha ŋgoreiya ramami le vakatha.” Thɨ gonjoghawe thɨŋa, “Ma ŋgamawobuna ghime! Ghime ramame mbe regha eŋge, Loi.”
Seitan le ŋgaŋga

Jisas i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Thoŋgo mbema emunjoru ramamiya Loi, valɨkaiwami hu gharethovu e ghino, kaiwae ghino Loi va i variyeŋgo na ya mena gheke. Mava ya mena mbe wombereghake eŋge elo renuwaŋa, nandere, va i variyeŋgo.
Buda kaiwae nuwamina ma i manjamanjalaŋa budakaiya ya utuŋa weŋga? Rɨghethoru kaiwae hu botewo hu vandeŋe lo utuke weŋga.

Ghemi ŋgoramiya ramami Seitan na nuwamiya hu vakatha ŋgoreiya ramami le vakatha. Va i menakowe na ghaghada noroke, iye ghakaiwo i gaboŋgiya gharɨgharɨ, na ma mbaŋa regha ina emunjoru ele valɨvaŋga, kaiwae ma mbaŋa regha i utuŋa emunjoru. Iye i butu e utu kwan, mbe ghathanavu vara iyako mbaŋake wolaghɨye kaiwae iye taukwan na kwanɨŋgike wolaghɨye ramanji.
Ko ghino kaiwae ya utuŋa utu emunjoru, iya kaiwae ma hu loŋweghathɨŋgo.
Thela regha e tɨnemina valɨkaiwae i woraŋgiya wothanavu raitharɨ? Thoŋgo ghino ya utuŋa utu emunjoru, buda kaiwae ma hu loŋweghathɨŋgo?
Thela Ramaya Loi, i loŋweya Loi ghalɨŋae. Ko iyemaeŋge kaiwae ma hu loŋwe Loi, iyake i vaemunjoruŋa ghemi ma Loi le ŋgaŋga.”
Jisas na Eibraham
Jiu lenji randeviva thɨ gonjoghawe thɨŋa, “Mbema emunjoru va wo utuŋama mbaŋa va woŋa, ‘Ghen rara Sameriya ghen na nyao raitharɨ ina e ghen.’”
Jisas iŋa, “Ma nyao raitharɨ ina e ghino. Ghino ya yavwatatawana Bwebwe, ko iyemaeŋge ghemi ma hu yavwatata wanaŋgo.
Ghino ma nuwaŋguiya ya wovorevoreŋa wombereghake idaŋgu. Ko iyemaeŋge lolo regha mbe inawe, iye nuwaiya thɨ wovorevoreŋa idaŋgu na iye raghatha thovuye moli.
Ya dage emunjoru e ghemi, thela thoŋgo i ghambugha lo utuke mane i mare.”

Jiu thɨ dagewe thɨŋa, “Mbaŋake wo ghareghare mbema emunjoru nyao raitharɨ ina e ghen! Eibraham va i mare na tembe ŋgoreiyeva Loi ghalɨŋae gharautuŋgi, ko iyemaeŋge uŋa, ‘Thela thoŋgo i ghambugha lo utuke mane i mare.’
Ghen u munjeva u laghɨye kivwala ramame Eibraham, ae? Kaerova i mare na tembe ŋgoreiyeva Loi ghalɨŋae gharautuŋgi. Ko thela ida ghen?”
Jisas i gonjogha weŋgi iŋa, “Thoŋgo ghino wombereghake ya taraweŋaŋgo, wo tarawako iyako ma e ghathovuye. Ko wo ratarawa mbe ghamberegha eŋge Bwebwe — amalaghɨniye iya huŋana lemi Loi.
Ghemi ma hu ghareghare Loi, ghino eŋge ya ghareghare. Thoŋgo yaŋa ma ya ghareghare Loi ne taukwana ghino ŋgoreiya ghemi; ko iyemaeŋge ya ghareghare amalaghɨniye na ya ghambugha ghalɨŋae.
Ramami Eibraham va i warari, le renuwaŋa va nuwaiya i thuwe wo mbaŋa; kaerova i thuwe na i warari laghɨye.”
Jiu thɨ dagewe thɨŋa, “Ghanɨtheghathegha mamba i wo ghwelima na uŋava va u thuwathuwa weya amalaghɨniye.”
Jisas i gonjogha weŋgi iŋa, “Ya dage emunjoru e ghemi, amba muyai Eibraham va i virɨ ghino vama inaŋguwe.”
Iyake kaiwae thɨ bigiya varɨvarɨ na thɨ munjeva thɨ unɨghɨwe, ko iyemaeŋge va i kubaroŋgi na i iteta Ŋgolo Boboma.
